name: Multi-Agent Engineering Board
description: Generic multi-agent software engineering board with atomic task claiming, git worktree isolation, A2A protocol dispatch, and FIFO resource locks.
board_background_md: Use this board to coordinate autonomous coding agents across isolated git worktrees via MCP and A2A v0.2.1. Default routing uses Frontier Orchestrators in `triage` (to research and write unambiguous specs), Mid-Range / Local Workers at high/max care in `todo` & `in-progress`, Cross-Vendor Reviewers in `review`, and Frontier Failure-Diagnosticians in `blocked`.

skill_config.description: How to pick up, work, triage, review, and hand back a task on the shared Kanbanana MCP board without clashing with other agents.
skill_config.custom_rules_md:
- Always work in an isolated git worktree (`board/<ticket-code>`).
- Triage Orchestrators must write mid-range-worker-ready specs (`files_md` exact paths, `do_md` exact signatures + steps + Out-of-Scope, `done_when_md` runnable verification commands) and avoid over-decomposing simple tasks.
- Implementation Workers must obey `files_md`/`do_md` scope strictly; if verification fails twice, stop looping and escalate to `blocked` for a Frontier Diagnostician.
- Run the test suite and linter before moving a ticket to `review`, and release any held resource locks when finished.
